title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-11 07:52:49 最新章节：二一九一 化作尘埃消散去 身融火光万物明
content_zh:
上古时期以来，宇宙间氤氲灵气滋养生机，使得万物灵智初开，而后便为争夺方寸之地，殊死相争。于是哀鸿遍野，万物开始视力量为尊，追求修仙之道，竟渐渐有了雏形，皆唤之功法，奉为传世之物。
西方贫瘠之地，有一妖兽竟侥幸悟得长生之道，修炼三千七百年，化为人形，圈地为王，夺得无数珍宝，自诩“枯槁老仙”，率领万千妖兽称霸一方，甚是快活。
老仙偶得天外陨铁，其材质甚是坚硬，遂率众妖日夜打造百年光景，终锤制成一柄约莫两尺，坑坑洼洼的黑色古刀。唤其为“石欠刃”，又欲在古刀上书其名，而石欠刃却材质坚固，老仙日雕月琢也不过歪歪扭扭的刻完石欠二字，而后便呲牙咧嘴耗尽耐心只得作罢，又因所得宝物之喜，叽叽喳喳的笑闹开来。老仙生性顽劣，所到之处鸡犬不宁，惹得许多是非。
于是大陆上便得传闻，有一身高近一丈，形容单薄，枯骨嶙峋，虎眉豹目，面部棱角分明塌鼻梁的妖物使得民不聊生。众仙家道士初闻其事时皆袖手旁观，后得之枯槁老仙所持珍宝功法无数，便呼朋唤友打一大旗“替天行道”，浩浩荡荡奔向老仙的“枯槁仙府”。
来到府前，却见光秃秃的山脉下开着一道缺口，前方撇着一块坑坑洼洼的巨石，权当是刻着府名的牌匾，缺口中钻出一个一丈高的干瘦家伙，手持一柄短刀，单手掐腰，吱吱哇哇叫闹的妖物，身后更是挤满了奇形怪状的妖兽，种类繁多，是说不出的怪异。
这些修仙之士便二话不说，纷纷念起口诀，但见漫天金光碧影，各种法器纷纷祭出，在妖兽中炸开了花，惹得枯槁老仙大怒，于是便战在一起，仙家道士们却未想其力道奇大无比，众人皆是一个照面，就败下阵来。
仙家中却有一黑发黑须，眉毛雪白面色红润的老者尤为醒目。此人乃是当今第一门派玉壶宗的建派者——明远老祖。却仿佛置身世外，表情淡然，毫无出手之意，手持一掩盖儿的碧玉葫芦，微眯着双眼等待时机。
再看这众人已经战到了黑夜，就在众人难解难分之时，明远老祖眼中精光一闪，高喝一声，那碧玉葫芦却晃晃悠悠的迎着与众人激战的枯槁老仙飞了过去，那枯槁老仙感觉眼前一晃，便抄起武器一挡，却是被那葫芦击退了几步。
那葫芦此时却发出微弱的红光，老仙的身体渐渐发出一种焦灼气息，立觉不妙，于是慌忙逃窜，可是那葫芦却盖子一开，就要把那老仙吸进葫芦内。
老仙发出一声吱吱哇哇嘶吼，又仿佛是叹息，目光中带着一丝不舍与决然将浑身的气力都流入了他右手的石欠刃中，恋恋不舍又隐蔽的将其射入夜色中。
而后老仙便化成一缕黑烟，被吸入葫芦内，那葫芦剧烈的晃动一番之后便毫无声息。众妖见状便做鸟兽状纷纷逃也开来。
众仙家道士互相看了看眼色，便打消了追赶之意。只是感叹明远老祖的道法玄妙，暗暗乍舌，但撇见葫芦毫无异样，便招呼各子弟子，将“枯槁仙府”掠夺一空，又瓜分了宝物，便面带喜色，打道回府。明远老祖却眉头紧蹙瞥向远处，又正眼看了看葫芦，摇了摇头也御空离去。
此后，又过去了许久年月，明远老祖在入世修炼之前，在玉壶峰门前石碑上留下了几行文字，便御空离去，此后再无其传闻，惹得众人心生疑惑，却又毫无头绪。而那神秘的文字却成为乡间孩子们嬉戏时的童谣“子虚善恶子虚僧，乌有垂髫乌有翁；岁岁年年是今日，年年岁岁何有终”。

content_en:
Since ancient times, the dense spiritual energy in the universe has nourished vitality, allowing all living things to develop their spiritual wisdom, and then they have been fighting to the death for space. As a result, mourning flooded the land, and all living things began to regard power as their esteem, and the pursuit of the path to immortality gradually took shape. They all summoned the skills and regarded them as things passed down from generation to generation.
In the barren land of the west, there was a monster that luckily understood the way to immortality. After practicing for 3,700 years, he transformed into a human form and became the king of the land. He won countless treasures and called himself the "Withered Old Immortal". He led thousands of monsters to dominate an area and was very happy.
The old immortal accidentally obtained meteorite iron from the sky. The material was very hard, so he led the demons to create a century-old scene day and night, and finally hammered it into an ancient black sword that was about two feet long and had many pits. He called it "Shi Qianbian" and wanted to write his name on the ancient sword, but the stone Qianbian was made of solid material. The old immortal couldn't finish carving the word "Shiqian" crookedly, and then he grinned and ran out of patience and had to give up. He was so happy with the treasure that he got it, and burst into laughter. The old immortal is naughty by nature, making chickens and dogs restless wherever he goes, causing a lot of trouble.
So there were rumors on the mainland that there was a monster that was nearly a foot tall, with a thin appearance, rugged bones, tiger-like eyebrows and leopard-like eyes, and an angular face with a flat nose, making people's lives miserable. When all the Taoist priests of the Immortal Family first heard about it, they all stood by and watched. Later, they learned that the withered old immortal had countless treasures and skills, so they called on their friends and called their friends to "do justice for heaven" and rushed to the old immortal's "withered immortal mansion".
When I arrived at the house, I saw a gap under the bare mountains. In front of it was a huge, pitted stone, which was supposed to be a plaque with the name of the house. A skinny guy about ten feet tall came out of the gap. He was holding a short knife and pinching his waist with one hand. He was a squeaking monster. Behind him was a crowd of strange monsters. There were many kinds of monsters, and they were indescribably weird.
These immortal cultivators said nothing and recited the formulas one after another. However, they saw the sky filled with golden light and green shadows, and various magic weapons were sacrificed one after another, exploding flowers among the monsters. This made the withered old immortal furious, so they fought together. However, the Taoist priests of the Immortal Family did not expect that their power was incomparable. They were all defeated at the same time.
In the fairy home, there is an old man with black hair, black beard, snow-white eyebrows and ruddy complexion who is particularly eye-catching. This person is the founder of the first sect of the Yuhu Sect today - Ancestor Mingyuan. But he seemed to be outside the world, with an indifferent expression and no intention of taking action. He was holding a covered jade gourd, squinting his eyes slightly and waiting for the opportunity.
Seeing that everyone had been fighting into the night, and just when everyone was in trouble, Mingyuan Ancestor's eyes flashed, and he shouted loudly, but the jade gourd flew towards the withered old immortal who was fighting fiercely with everyone. The withered old immortal felt his eyes flicker, and he picked up his weapon to block, but was knocked back a few steps by the gourd.
The gourd was emitting a faint red light at this time, and the old immortal's body gradually gave out an anxious aura. He immediately felt that something was not good, so he ran away in a hurry, but as soon as the lid of the gourd was opened, the old immortal was sucked into the gourd.
The old immortal let out a squeaking roar, which seemed to be a sigh. With a trace of reluctance and determination in his eyes, all the strength in his body flowed into the stone blade in his right hand, and he shot it into the night reluctantly and covertly.
Then the old immortal turned into a plume of black smoke and was sucked into the gourd. The gourd shook violently and then became silent. When the demons saw this, they fled away like birds and beasts.
The Taoist priests of the Immortal Family looked at each other and gave up their intention to pursue. He just sighed at the mysteries of the Taoism of ancestor Mingyuan, and secretly sighed, but seeing that the gourd was no different, he called his disciples, plundered the "Withered Immortal Mansion", divided the treasures, and returned home with a happy face. Ancestor Mingyuan frowned and glanced into the distance, then looked at the gourd, shook his head and left in the air.
After that, many years passed. Before ancestor Mingyuan entered the world and practiced cultivation, he left a few lines of writing on the stone tablet in front of the Yuhu Peak Gate, and then left in the air.Since then, there have been no more rumors about it, which has aroused everyone's doubts, but they have no clue. But that mysterious text has become a nursery rhyme for children in the countryside when they play, "The good and evil are empty, the monk is empty, there is no old man, there is no old man; every year is today, and every year has no end."
